articles.title_en: Distinctively Black Names and Educational Outcomes
articles.title_cn: 显著黑人名字与教育成果
articles.abstract_en: Names can convey information about race or ethnicity and therefore can be used to discriminate against protected groups; many researchers have demonstrated as much through audit studies. Yet few studies link life outcomes with names using observational data. We use administrative data from over 3 million Black students to ask whether those with more statistically Black names have differential educational outcomes. We find that while test scores, college enrollment, and college completion are negatively correlated with Black names net of background characteristics, this relationship is absent when we compare across siblings within households.
articles.abstract_cn: 名字可以传达关于种族或民族的信息，因此可以被用来歧视受保护群体；许多研究者已通过审计研究证明了这一点。然而，很少有研究使用观测数据将生活结果与名字联系起来。我们使用超过3万黑人学生的行政数据，探究那些名字在统计上更具黑人特征的学生是否在教育成果上存在差异。我们发现，尽管在控制背景特征后，考试成绩、大学入学率和大学完成率与黑人名字呈负相关，但在比较同一家庭内的兄弟姐妹时，这种关系并不存在。

articles.title_cn: 具有未观测链接的社会网络
articles.abstract_en: We point-identify and estimate linear social network models without observing any network links. The required data consist of many small networks of individuals, such as classrooms or villages, with individuals who are each observed only once. We apply our estimator to data from Tennessee’s Project STAR (Student-Teacher Achievement Ratio). Without observing the latent network in each classroom, we identify and estimate peer and contextual effects on students’ performance in mathematics. We find that peer effects tend to be larger in bigger classes and that increasing peer effects would significantly improve students’ average test scores in some classes.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们在不观测任何网络链接的情况下，对线性社会网络模型进行点识别和估计。所需数据由许多小型个体网络组成，如教室或村庄，其中每个个体仅被观测一次。我们将估计器应用于田纳西州“学生教师成就比率”（Project STAR）的数据。在不观测每个教室中潜在网络的情况下，我们识别并估计了同伴效应和情境效应对学生数学成绩的影响。我们发现，在较大的班级中同伴效应往往更大，且增强同伴效应将显著提高某些班级学生的平均考试成绩。

articles.title_en: Self-Fulfilling Prophecies, Quasi Nonergodicity, and Wealth Inequality
articles.title_cn: 自我实现的预言、准非遍历性与财富不平等
articles.abstract_en: We construct a model of an exchange economy in which agents trade assets contingent on an observable signal, the probability of which depends on public opinion. The agents in our model are replaced occasionally, and each person updates beliefs in response to observed outcomes. We show that the distribution of the observed signal is described by a quasi-nonergodic process and that people continue to disagree with each other forever. These disagreements generate large wealth inequalities that arise from the multiplicative nature of wealth dynamics, which makes successful bold bets highly profitable.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个交换经济模型，其中代理人交易依赖于可观察信号的或有资产，该信号的概率取决于公众舆论。模型中的代理人偶尔会被替换，每个人都会根据观察到的结果更新信念。我们表明，可观察信号的分布由准非遍历过程描述，并且人们会永远持续相互分歧。这些分歧产生了巨大的财富不平等，这些不平等源于财富动态的乘数性质，这使得成功的激进赌注变得高度有利可图。

articles.title_en: Race, Representation, and Local Governments in the US South: The Effect of the Voting Rights Act
articles.title_cn: 种族、代表与美国南部的地方政府：《投票权法案》的影响
articles.abstract_en: The Voting Rights Act of 1965 redefined race relations in the United States. Yet evidence on its effect on Black office holding remains scant. Using novel data on Black elected officials between 1962 and 1980, we assess the impact of the Voting Rights Act on the racial makeup of local governments in the Deep South. Exploiting predetermined differential exposure of Southern counties to the mandated federal intervention, we show that the latter fostered local Black office holding, particularly in the powerful county commissions, controlling local public finances. In the presence of election by district, covered counties experienced Black representation gains and faster capital spending growth.
articles.abstract_cn: 1965年的《投票权法案》重新定义了美国的种族关系。然而，关于其对黑人担任公职影响的证据仍然稀少。利用1962年至1980年间关于黑人当选官员的新数据，我们评估了《投票权法案》对深南部地方政府种族构成的影响。利用南方各县对强制性联邦干预的预定差异暴露，我们表明后者促进了地方黑人担任公职，特别是在控制地方公共财政的强大县委员会中。在按选区选举的情况下，被覆盖的县经历了黑人代表权的增加和资本支出增长的加快。

articles.title_en: The Multidimensional Impact of Teachers on Students
articles.title_cn: 教师对学生影响的多维度分析
articles.abstract_en: Test score measures of teacher quality may not fully capture teachers’ impact on students. We use test score and non–test score measures of student achievement and behavior to estimate multiple dimensions of teacher quality. We find that these two measures of teacher quality are only weakly correlated and that both affect students’ high school performance. A teacher removal simulation that uses both measures improves most long-term student outcomes by over 50%, compared to a policy that uses test scores alone. Our results also show that for high school outcomes the effects of teachers in later grades are larger than those in earlier grades and that performance in core elementary school subjects matters more than that in other subjects.
articles.abstract_cn: 基于考试成绩的教师质量衡量标准可能无法完全反映教师对学生的影响。我们利用学生的考试成绩和非考试成绩指标来衡量学生成就和行为，从而估计教师质量的多维度。我们发现，这两种教师质量衡量标准仅存在弱相关性，且两者均影响学生的高中表现。一项同时使用这两种衡量标准的教师移除模拟，相较于仅使用考试成绩的政策，能改善大多数长期学生成果超过50%。我们的结果还表明，对于高中成果，高年级教师的影响大于低年级教师，且小学核心科目的表现比其他科目更为重要。
